title: Worked Well
text: Worked Well. Had this fan running non stop for two years in my small bedroom but then it stopped so I'm buying another one. Grill was impossible to attach so had to leave it off. High enough not to be a problem but hope the next one does not have this issue. I'm retired so money is tight  or I would have purchased a different one..

product_metadata.title: Comfort Zone CZ16WR 16" Quiet 3-Speed Wall Mount Fan with Remote Control, Timer and Adjustable Tilt, White
features: 🌬️VERSATILE 3-SPEED SETTINGS: Tailor the airflow to your needs and comfort level with the 3-speed functionality of this wall mount fan. Choose between low, medium, or high speed settings to create the ideal environment. Whether you prefer a gentle breeze for relaxation, a moderate airflow for productivity, or a powerful gust of air to cool down quickly, this fan offers the flexibility to cater to your preferences. Enjoy personalized comfort and optimal air circulation with ease, thanks to the speed options of this versatile wall mount fan.

🌬️ENHANCED SAFETY FEATURES: Prioritizing your safety, this 3-speed oscillating fan incorporates a thoughtful design with a safety grill. This protective barrier ensures a safe distance between users and the moving blades while the fan is in operation, providing peace of mind and preventing accidental contact. Rest assured as you enjoy the refreshing airflow, knowing that the fan's safe design puts your well-being first. Embrace a worry-free cooling experience with the added assurance of this fan's enhanced safety measures.

🌬️PERSONALIZED COMFORT OPTIONS: Indulge in customized comfort with the versatile features of this fan. It provides a range of options to suit your preferences, including normal and sleep modes, as well as a variable timer. Whether you desire a gentle breeze for relaxation or a soothing airflow for a good night's sleep, this fan caters to your unique comfort needs. Adjusting these settings is a breeze, as you can conveniently make changes from the front panel or utilize the included remote control for effortless customization

🌬️EFFORTLESS CONTROL: Enjoy the convenience with the included full-function remote control, granting you effortless control over your fan from a distance. With this remote, you can conveniently change speed settings, set timers, select fan modes, and power the fan on and off with ease. No need to get up or interrupt your activities; simply sit back and adjust your fan's settings according to your preferences from the comfort of your couch or bed. Embrace the ultimate convenience of remote control functionality, enhancing your experience.

🌬️DYNAMIC OSCILLATION: Experience air circulation and efficient performance with the 90-degree oscillation feature of this fan. With the ability to oscillate and an adjustable tilt function, it ensures the distribution of air across a wider area. This dynamic oscillation effectively promotes optimal airflow and evenly circulates cool air throughout the room. Enjoy a refreshing breeze that reaches every corner, providing a comfortable and pleasant environment. Embrace the benefits of improved air circulation and efficient performance.
description: The Comfort Zone 16" 3-Speed Wall Mount Fan with Remote Control makes it easier than ever to take control of your comfort. Equipped with three convenient speed settings, this quiet indoor fan lets you choose between low-, medium- and high-velocity output for efficient air circulation and optimized airflow that suits your space and your comfort level. Whether for home or office use, this 3-speed wall mount fan is a convenient way to keep cool.

In addition to the three speed settings, you can choose from normal and sleep modes to further customize the cooling power of your wall mount indoor fan. You can also set the variable length timer, so you won’t have to worry about shutting off your fan if you get wrapped up in work. All of these functions, as well an on-and-off power control, are easily accessed from the clearly labelled front control panel or the convenient remote control.

This quiet room fan offers 90-degree oscillation to comfortably distribute air throughout the room. It also has an adjustable tilt function that allows you to easily direct the airflow and lock it into place for targeted cooling where you need it. Position this 3-speed oscillating fan in any room to enjoy widespread cooling and efficient performance with the touch of a button.

A convenient and quiet fan with timer and remote is a welcome addition to any home or workspace. Whether you need to concentrate on business, schoolwork, your favorite television program or getting a good night’s sleep, this quiet indoor fan will keep you cool without causing unnecessary disruption. The included wall-mounting bracket makes installation quick and easy and once it’s up, the safety grill protects users from moving blades while the fan is in operation.
